q: Shearer's Lemma gives a submodular bound on joint entropy. For a collection F of subsets of [n] where each index appears in ≥k sets:
exp: Shearer: H(X₁,...,Xₙ) ≤ (1/k)∑_{S∈F} H(X_S). Averaging the entropy of each S over F, and using submodularity, gives the bound. Application: Loomis–Whitney inequality (product of projection sizes bounds the volume).
